entry_point_analyzer.note: Via Slither MCP: list_functions on AMMModule, ModuleFeeCollection, LimitBreakAMM entry points

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flag clearing in _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers enables direct collectHookFeesByHook
ruled_out_vectors.analysis: At line 3190, _setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) clears all custom flags during queued fee distribution. Token transfer callbacks can call collectHookFeesByHook which takes the direct-transfer path instead of queueing. However, _transferHookFeesByHook decrements tokensOwed[hookFeeKey] BEFORE the transfer, and the underflow check prevents extracting more than owed. The ENTERED bit prevents re-entry to nonReentrant functions.

executor.call{value: excess}('') sends ETH before balance verification at line 2208. ENTERED bit prevents AMM re-entry. External protocols observing state see consistent reserves because pool state was already updated. Read-only reentrancy only affects external integrators, not the AMM itself.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Cross-contract reentrancy between AMM and CLOB
ruled_out_vectors.analysis: AMM and CLOB have separate TstorishReentrancyGuardWithFlags. During AMM callbacks to CLOB, CLOB guard may be released. But CLOB's ammHandleTransfer checks msg.sender == AMM, and the CLOB's depositToken rejects fee-on-transfer tokens. No path to profit extraction.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Transient storage slot leaking between operations in same TX
ruled_out_vectors.analysis: Known by-design: AMMStandardHook stores direct swap amount at DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT. Second token's beforeSwap overwrites first's. By-design per audit_memory FP #1.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Output swap rounding extraction via tiny amounts
ruled_out_vectors.analysis: Output swaps use mulDivRoundingUp (user pays more). Input swaps use mulDiv (user pays less). 25 iterations of tiny output+input round-trips showed no profit. Protocol-favorable rounding confirmed.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Multi-hop output swap fee composition amplification
ruled_out_vectors.analysis: Each hop in multi-hop output swap correctly propagates amountIn from current hop as amountOut for next hop. Fee adjustments (exchange, feeOnTop, hook) are applied at the correct stages. No fee double-counting observed.

_storeNonTokenHookFees uses hash(hook, hash(tokenFor, tokenFor)) while _transferHookFeesByHook uses hash(hook, hash(tokenFor, tokenFee)). Keys match only when tokenFor==tokenFee. For non-token hooks (pool/liquidity), fee token IS always the same as tokenFor. By-design.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Pool type state desync via direct calls
ruled_out_vectors.analysis: DynamicPoolType uses globalState[msg.sender] keying. Direct calls to pool type by non-AMM addresses write to their own isolated storage. Cannot affect AMM's pool state.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Reserve-balance desync from exchange fee handling
ruled_out_vectors.analysis: Exchange fees are deducted from amountIn BEFORE pool swap and transferred to fee recipient after token collection. Balance check at line 2208 validates exact token receipt. Token conservation verified: alice_spent = amm_received + fee_to_recipient.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Cumulative rounding drift from alternating swaps
ruled_out_vectors.analysis: 100 alternating small-amount swaps (0.001 tokens each) showed no cumulative rounding profit. Constant-product math with protocol-favorable rounding ensures trader loses on each round-trip.
Flash loan -> swap -> reverse swap -> repay always results in net loss due to LP fees (30bps) and flash loan fee. Fuzz tested with random amounts.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Near-boundary reserve drain causing solvency violation
ruled_out_vectors.analysis: Swapping 99% of one reserve's worth doesn't violate solvency. Constant product ensures output < reserve. _safeDecrementUint128 prevents underflow.

theft_theses.thesis: Extract tokens via reentrancy during hook fee distribution when flags are cleared
theft_theses.detail: tokensOwed decremented before transfer prevents double-spend. ENTERED bit prevents nonReentrant re-entry even when custom flags cleared.

theft_theses.thesis: Drain pool reserves via cumulative rounding extraction from alternating swaps
theft_theses.detail: Protocol-favorable rounding (mulDiv down for input, mulDivRoundingUp for output) ensures trader loses on every round-trip. 100-swap test confirms no drift.

theft_theses.thesis: Steal hook fees via key mismatch between _storeNonTokenHookFees and _transferHookFeesByHook
theft_theses.detail: Keys match when tokenFor==tokenFee, which is always true for pool and liquidity hooks. Token hooks use _storeHookFees which has correct key derivation.

theft_theses.thesis: Flash loan + swap round-trip to extract value from pool
theft_theses.detail: Net loss from LP fees (30bps) + flash loan fee makes round-trip unprofitable. Fuzz tested with random amounts.

theft_theses.thesis: Manipulate pool type state via direct calls to bypass AMM accounting
theft_theses.detail: DynamicPoolType uses globalState[msg.sender] keying, isolating each caller's state. Direct calls cannot affect AMM's pool state.

hypothesis_results.detail: _storeNonTokenHookFees key mismatch is by-design: tokenFor==tokenFee always holds for pool/liquidity hooks
